def insertionSort (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond (xs)) : List Int :=
  xs.foldl (fun acc x =>
    let sorted_acc := acc
    let insert x' l :=
      match l with
      | [] => [x']
      | y :: ys =>
        if x' ≤ y then x' :: y :: ys
        else y :: insert x' ys
    insert x sorted_acc
  ) []
